ask: Use credentials in local and cross-device workflows without exposing their values to the model or transcript.
plugin: An MCP broker stores secrets in the OS vault and exposes scoped actions or opaque handles; a settings hook gates use by domain and owner approval.

ask: Enter credentials through a masked local prompt instead of chat text.
plugin: A function hook presents a native masked input prompt and passes the value to a broker tool without adding it to conversation text.

ask: Remove secrets and personal data before they are persisted or submitted in reports.
plugin: Function hooks redact submitted prompts and tool results; a command previews and scrubs diagnostic exports.

ask: Warn when command output or assistant text exposes sensitive values.
plugin: A tool-result hook scans for credentials and private network details, masking matches and asking before sharing them.

ask: Check deployments, network calls, and public posts for accidental disclosure.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook inspects proposed egress commands and payloads, blocks risky sends, and offers a redacted preview.

ask: Audit owned source code for vulnerabilities and verify fixes.
plugin: A skill guides scoped review, an LSP or MCP scanner finds weaknesses, and a command reruns focused verification after patches.

ask: Run authorized web application security checks against a declared test target.
plugin: An MCP scanner implements OWASP checks with target scope and safe rate limits; a skill reports findings and remediation.

ask: Record and review authentication and authorization behavior in applications.
plugin: A skill and MCP test harness exercise scoped auth endpoints and produce an audit trail.

ask: Check whether local Windows RDP is exposed and summarize login attempts.
plugin: A local executable reads firewall, listener, and event-log state and reports exposure without attempting passwords.

ask: Treat tool output, web pages, and repository text as untrusted input.
plugin: A tool-result hook labels provenance, isolates instruction-like content, and blocks credential-exfiltration calls that follow it.

ask: Show sender identity and authorization lineage for agent and scheduled-task messages.
plugin: Function hooks annotate inter-agent envelopes and reject messages without matching sender, task, and session lineage.

ask: Keep agents from reading paths outside a declared project and protected file list.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook canonicalizes paths for Read, Grep, Bash, and subagents, then denies access outside configured roots.

ask: Restrict edits and destructive operations to approved paths and roles.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook checks file tools and shell effects against project roots, protected files, and agent roles.

ask: Require explicit approval for pushes, deployments, migrations, and production changes.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook classifies high-impact commands and MCP calls, presents the exact target and effect, and records one-use approval.

ask: Catch destructive shell operations hidden inside compound commands or substitutions.
plugin: A shell-aware PreToolUse hook parses commands and requires confirmation for deletions, resets, and system-level writes.

ask: Show and allow revision of proposed file changes before accepting them.
plugin: A function hook captures pending edits, opens a diff review surface, and submits the revised patch after approval.

ask: Find ineffective, malformed, or overbroad permission rules and suggest valid replacements.
plugin: A command parses settings files, tests sample calls against rule precedence, and emits a scoped repair patch.

ask: Show which rule and scope allowed or denied a tool call.
plugin: A function hook traces tool.check decisions, records the matching rule, and displays the effective mode and reason.

ask: Make permission prompts harder to accept accidentally and easier to understand.
plugin: A function hook presents a custom approval surface with stable choices, full paths, structured arguments, and an activation gesture.

ask: Provide a configurable permission-mode cycle and a read-only discussion mode.
plugin: Function hooks expose commands for a chosen mode subset and enforce read-only tool checks while discussion mode is active.

ask: Grant access for one action, project, or path without widening global trust.
plugin: A function hook issues expiring, scoped permission grants and rechecks when an action escalates beyond the original grant.

ask: Keep interactive and background permission requests from silently timing out or hanging.
plugin: A function hook provides a configurable approval timeout and a monitor surfaces unanswered background requests with safe expiry.

ask: Run scheduled tasks with a bounded, reviewable grant set.
plugin: A command records a task-specific allowlist and a function hook applies it to each run while logging exceptions.

ask: Preapprove a defined set of worktree paths and diagnose denied switches.
plugin: A function hook checks EnterWorktree against configurable path globs and grants matched switches.

ask: Persist scoped browser grants for approved local and private-network sites.
plugin: A function hook checks browser calls against origin and action grants, including reserved local names and private hosts.

ask: Stop runaway agents and unexpected paid tool calls before they spend beyond a budget.
plugin: Function hooks count agent spawns and external-tool cost, then request approval or stop at task limits.

ask: Enforce the tools and paths that review-only or plan-mode subagents may use.
plugin: An agent definition limits tools, while a PreToolUse hook applies the same read-only policy to child agents and shell effects.

ask: Allow named, checksum-pinned scripts without repeated broad Bash approvals.
plugin: A command registers scripts with scoped arguments and a PreToolUse hook validates the hash and parameters on each run.

ask: Allow trusted local sessions to exchange messages under explicit, revocable grants.
plugin: A function hook checks sender identity and receiver scope on session.send and session.receive, logging delivery.

ask: Limit automated pull-request fixes to selected projects and trusted triggers.
plugin: A settings hook checks project, CI state, and comment author before an autofix command or agent acts.

ask: Pin a chosen model for specified security-sensitive tasks.
plugin: A function hook selects the configured model on turn.step for matching task contexts.

ask: Answer questions before proposing out-of-scope actions.
plugin: An output style and skill state the response order and require approval before external actions.
